biggest_catch: Your friend must open a MyLife Checking Account and complete the Qualifying Transactions in the specified timeframe - otherwise no incentive.
catches: Referrer: USALLIANCE Financial member 18+ with an SMA Checking or MyLife Checking account in good standing, not subject to suspension or closure for cause.
Referrer receives $25.00 per referral; 'Eligible Referrers can earn a maximum of 10 incentives per year, for a total of $250.00 per calendar year.'
Referred Friend must: not be a current or former member, open a MyLife Checking Account via the unique referral link, and complete the Qualifying Transactions within the specified timeframe.

Referrals must be made only to individuals with whom the referrer has a personal relationship; bulk distribution, spam, public posting of referral links, referral-farming sites, paid ads, and reciprocal/chain referrals are prohibited.
USALLIANCE may delay, withhold, deny, or reverse any reward for fraud, abuse, ineligible activity, or system error; arbitration and class-action waiver apply.
Program may be cancelled, modified, or terminated at any time.
US resident 18+ only; arbitration/class action waiver in the Truth-in-Savings/Membership Agreement applies.
